localChanges: Split the render hot-path items to match how they actually group:
The image/canvas cloning item (#6) absorbs the zero-width getImageData crash (#8) -- both come from getPreloadedImage returning a detached cloneNode(), which is neither rendered nor decoded.

The blink tick splits in two. Restricting it to the active unit's region needs a partial portal composite, because ActiveUnit is the topmost layer and un-drawing it means restoring the pixels beneath, so that half moves to the dirty-rect work (#7). The half that needs none of that machinery is #45.
Also fold the science-window turns count and the map edge lock into the existing entries for their tickets (#15, #13), rather than leaving them under the rendering heading.
